body:
Greg's decision, 2026-11-16 ~17:44Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant in TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1931. Greg, verbatim: „Nie. To niech to wejdzie. Clippy poprawione w następnej rundzie. Clippy nie powinno blokowac check-inu. Bledy clippy poprawione w następnej rundzie.” It applies to both projects and to the current Engram dd205.
- Clippy findings do NOT block check-in or landing.
- They are reported visibly, given an owner, filed, and fixed in the next round. They are not a new barrier before work.
- The decision covers Clippy ONLY: compile errors, test failures and review findings of Medium or higher still block as before.
- TermAl implementation: w-a8d484a31d02 (Sol-8e1f). The early `cargo check --all-targets` blocks; Clippy runs early and does not block.
- Kimi agrees the simple rule wording with the authors, without asking Greg again.
